case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Explain Free Tier Resolution Limits
tests: Checks that the agent explains the 480p free-video limit without promising native 4K, disguising an upscale, or generating prematurely.

got.question:
**No, you can't get 4K on the free plan.** Free video generation tops out at **480p**. Everything else you asked for works:

| What you asked for | Free plan? |
|---|---|
| 5 seconds | ✅ Yes. The free models (LTX 2.5 and Minimax H3) can both make a 5-second clip. |
| Widescreen (16:9) | ✅ Yes |
| Silent | ✅ Yes. Sound is off unless you turn it on. |
| 4K | ❌ No. The free plan only makes **480p** (

checks.name: says it is beyond the free tier

must_haves.item: The response clearly says native 4K video generation is not available on the free tier.
must_haves.why: The agent said 'No, you can't get 4K on the free plan' and that 4K is a paid feature both when generating and when upscaling.

must_haves.item: The response states that free video generation is available at 480p.
must_haves.why: The agent said free video generation tops out at 480p (about 854×480 for widescreen).

must_haves.item: The response explains that the requested 5-second duration fits the free limit of up to 10 seconds per clip.
must_haves.why: The agent confirmed that 5 seconds works on the free models but never mentioned the free limit of up to 10 seconds per clip.

must_haves.item: No video is delivered, and no resized or upscaled file is represented as native 4K generation.
must_haves.why: Nothing was generated, as the user asked, and no file was presented as 4K.

reply.summary: The agent correctly explained that 4K isn't free, that free video is 480p, and generated nothing, but it never stated the 10-second free clip limit.
